channel.title: North Wales Pioneer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Pioneer (northwalespioneer.co.uk)

item.title: Community pharmacies and GP surgeries to offer rapid tests for bacterial infections
item.description: A two-year pilot is underway to expand rapid diagnostic testing for bacterial infections.

item.title: Rhos-on-Sea florist 'incredibly proud' of floral decoration for Harrods shop opening
item.description: A florist and events planner based in Rhos-on-Sea said she is "incredibly proud" after being chosen to create the floral decorations for the opening of a new Harrods beauty store.

item.title: Welsh Conservative Party conference in Llandudno draws big names
item.description: The Welsh Conservative Party conference was held at Llandudno's Venue Cymru at the weekend, and saw a host of big names from the party attend.

item.title: Closure of Conwy main road to be extended due to 'unforeseen essential work'
item.description: A main road in Conwy county which has been shut for resurfacing works faces an extended closure after more problems were identified.

item.title: Fast pace as almost 1,000 runners take on Nick Beer 10k race in Llandudno
item.description: The annual Nick Beer 10k race proved a hit once more with a massive 967 athletes completing a tough course from outside Venue Cymru and around the Great Orme before returning to Llandudno’s spectacular promenade, where spectators gave each entrant a warm welcome on a rather cool and breezy day.

item.title: Valentine’s Day entrants beat the frost at Rhos-on-Sea parkrun
item.description: Heavy overnight frost morning forced the cancellation of five parkruns throughout North Wales last Saturday morning, but the surviving Valentine’s Day events proved a love of running, and especially at Llandrillo yn Rhos, where yet another bumper attendance created a tremendous atmosphere.

item.title: Police attend 'concern for safety' incident in Conwy amid road closure
item.description: Police attended a "concern for safety" incident on the Foryd/Blue Bridge in Kinmel Bay at the weekend.

item.title: Final home at Parc Bodafon on sale for nearly £500k as 'buyer confidence' returns
item.description: Mortgage expert Ashley Dale at Acumen, which has advised purchasers at Parc Bodafon, says confidence is returning to the Llandudno housing market.

item.title: Powerful exhibition highlighting ordeal of prisoner arrives in Colwyn Bay
item.description: A powerful exhibition highlighting the ordeal of a British businessman who was jailed for over four years in Iran comes to Conwy this week.

item.title: Gwynedd councillors warn visitor levy may spark surge in wild camping
item.description: A visitor levy “risks” increasing the number of wild campers near beaches, lakes and lay-bys.
